failure_modes: No permitted edit has a defensible expected affinity advantage because decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable and all candidate signals are diagnostic descriptors.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so pair_kernel and joint-RMS effects cannot be expressed as an operative reward edit.
Directional shape or joint-RMS rules are contradicted by negative adjusted effects with high same-sign batch fraction (branch_adjusted:228, branch_adjusted:235, branch_adjusted:158).
Time-conditioned temporal edits are not distinguished from a constant rule because no polynomial was accepted and extrapolation is disallowed (curve_support, continuous_functions).
Teacher-neighbor edits rest on observational teacher score correlations that are not a fitted affinity predictor (information_audit).
Survival and turnover signals are confounded by thin ancestral coverage and by reclassification/parent weighting, not causal selection effects (lineage_support, turnover:14, turnover:17).
Any temperature proposal would be an interface violation; temperatures are immutable task parameters (fixed_parameters).

rationale: Retain the incumbent. The declared objective is final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable, so no supplied evidence establishes a defensible expected affinity advantage for any permitted edit. The strongest multiplicity-adjusted coordinate signals (pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 adjusted_covariance branch_adjusted:86 q=0.081 and branch_adjusted:87 q=0.077; adjusted_correlation branch_adjusted:240 q=0.019 and branch_adjusted:241 q=0.046; joint_internal_RMS_A branch_adjusted:153 q=0.030) are diagnostic descriptors, and the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so they cannot be expressed as an operative reward edit. Opposing evidence (shape_yy branch_adjusted:235 q=2.9e-4 and branch_adjusted:158 q=4.2e-5 negative with 1.0 same-sign batch fraction; joint_innovation_RMS raw_correlation branch_adjusted:228 negative) contradicts any rule treating all shape or joint-RMS reductions as favorable, so a directional edit is not defensible. Global pose terms are null (branch_adjusted:77-79 q>=0.86) and the landmark softmin/occupancy fields retain freedom with null adjusted effects (branch_adjusted:112 q=0.92; branch_adjusted:132 q=0.99), giving no evidence-bound region_index target. Continuous contrast curves for landmark_00 span the observed support with many sign changes and no accepted polynomial (continuous:4, continuous:7; curve_support legendre_runtime_allowed=false), so a time-conditioned temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit is not distinguished from a constant rule by validated fit. Teacher evidence is observational (information_audit compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A mean 0.081, top4_teacher_overlap 0.470; teacher score correlations 0.064-0.102) and not a fitted affinity predictor, so a teacher_neighbors change is not supported. Turnover residuals (turnover:14, turnover:17, turnover:134, turnover:224, turnover:497, turnover:584, turnover:587) are accounting diagnostics including reclassification and parent weighting, not causal selection effects, and survival enrichment is confounded by thin ancestral coverage (lineage_support: 349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors, 531 with fewer than 6). Temperatures are immutable task parameters (mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0) and no temperature edit is permitted. Retaining the incumbent is the valid choice under the affinity-first priority; the evidence that would change this decision is a decoded terminal affinity contrast or a validated absolute contrast that survives multiplicity adjustment and is expressible in the executing pointcloud scalar.
